paragraphs: Follett Software sells K-12 school districts operational suites for library, technology, and facilities work, meant to give a district a clear, defensible view of all its assets. The pitch to districts is that they should stop paying twice for assets they already own.

The tools are sorted by the job a person does, and described as tailored to meet people where they are. A technology team can manage resources and update devices. Library staff track library inventory. Instructional staff build and manage classroom materials. Business office users simplify fundraising, expenses, and reporting. The technology suite has a new IT asset manager.

The company says districts across the country choose it as a partner built for the pace and pressure of education. The homepage claims 99.9% platform uptime. It publishes a trends report on district operations, AI adoption, and customer success. It also hosts events that bring K-12 leaders together. The about page invites organizations interested in becoming an API partner.

quote.text: Powerful tools that simplify the complex work of running schools and districts.
